home.question: ඔබ අනාරක්ෂිතව සිටින බවක් දැනේද?
home.sosHintA11y: Starts a five-second countdown before sending an SOS. You can cancel during the countdown.
home.caption:
One tap alerts your trusted contacts.
You choose who follows your live location.
home.offline: No internet. GPS can still show your place. Sending an alert needs mobile data or SMS.

sosConfirm.title: SOS යවන්නද?
sosConfirm.lead: තත්පර පහේ ගණන් කිරීම දැන් ආරම්භ වේ. වරදක් නම් අවලංගු කරන්න.
sosConfirm.cancelledBody: ඇඟවීමක් යවා නැත. මෙම අවලංගු කිරීමෙන් සම්බන්ධතාවලට දැනුම් දී නැත.
sosConfirm.offlineSms: The server was unreachable. Review the SMS draft on your phone. Delivery is not confirmed until you send it.
sosConfirm.sendFailed: SOS යැවිය නොහැකි විය. මෙය යැවූ බවට සලකුණු නොකෙරේ.
sosConfirm.locationNeeded: Location permission is needed so trusted contacts can see where you are.
sosConfirm.phoneSmsOpened: දුරකථන Messages යෙදුම විවෘතයි. සම්බන්ධතා දැනුවත් කිරීමට SMS යවන්න.
sosConfirm.phoneSmsCancelled: SMS යවා නැත. ඊළඟ තිරයෙන් අමතන්න හෝ පණිවිඩයක් යවන්න.

sosActive.title: SOS
sosActive.headerSent: Alert request accepted. Delivery to each contact is shown below.
sosActive.headerPending: Alert is pending. The server could not confirm that messages were sent.
sosActive.headerFailed: Alert request failed for the contacts listed below.
sosActive.headerMixed: Some contacts were requested, some were not confirmed.
sosActive.empty: No trusted contacts were notified. Add contacts so the next alert can reach someone.
sosActive.metaSent: Provider accepted the request. This is not proof the message reached the recipient.
sosActive.metaPending: Delivery was not confirmed. You can send an SMS draft from this phone if available.

endSos.title: Are you safe now?
endSos.lead: Ending SOS stops this active session and live location sharing. Contacts already notified will not receive a new message unless you start SOS again.

location.liveNow: ● Live — updates while SOS is active
location.emptyBody: Pick trusted contacts who can follow you. They only see your location while sharing is on.
location.permissionOn: ස්ථාන අවසරය සක්රියයි. සම්බන්ධතා තෝරා ගත් පසු පමණක් බෙදාහැරීම ආරම්භ වේ.
location.offline: GPS may still work offline. Sending your location to contacts needs mobile data or SMS.

shareSheet.title: Share live location with
shareSheet.leadSos: Choose who can follow your live location. Sharing starts only after you confirm.
shareSheet.leadLocation: Choose who can see your location. Sharing starts only after you confirm.

contacts.title: විශ්වාසදායක සම්බන්ධතා
contacts.note: Tap a contact to edit. “SOS alerts” are requested automatically; “Live location” contacts are pre-ticked when you share.

contactForm.name: Name
contactForm.notifyBody: An alert is requested for this person when you trigger SOS
contactForm.preselectBody: Ticked by default when you share during SOS
contactForm.validation: Enter a name and a valid phone number.

privacy.title: පෞද්ගලිකත්වය සහ ස්ථානය
privacy.explain: Location is shared only with the trusted contacts you select, and only while sharing is on. Sharing stops when you tap stop, the chosen duration ends, or you end SOS.
privacy.liveBody: Master switch for all location sharing
privacy.autoBody: SOS alerts are requested for contacts you marked. This only decides whether ticked contacts see your location.
privacy.noContacts: Add trusted contacts before choosing who can follow you.

night.title: Travelling at night
night.body: Stay in well-lit and populated areas.

battery.title: Keep your phone charged
battery.body: A low battery can stop an SOS. Charge before a late trip.

share.title: Share your location when needed
share.body: Share with trusted people only while you want them to follow you.

aware.title: Stay aware
aware.body: Avoid isolated areas when you can.

route.title: Tell someone your route
route.body: Let a trusted contact know where you are going.

cancel.title: Cancel if you are safe
cancel.body: The SOS countdown lasts five seconds. Cancel if you pressed by mistake.

emergency.title: හදිසි සේවා
emergency.note: Phone calls can work without internet if you have mobile signal. Sending a SafeLink alert still needs data or SMS. Confirm these numbers for your area before you need them.
emergency.offline: You appear to be offline. You can still try calling these numbers if your phone has signal.

help.title: Help & Support

sos.title: How the SOS alert works
sos.body: Tap SOS, then cancel or wait five seconds. The app only requests an alert after the countdown. Status shows sent, pending, or failed from the service response — not a guess.

location.title: Sharing live location
location.body: After you confirm, selected contacts can follow you for the time you chose. Sharing stops when you end SOS or tap stop.

offline.title: What if I have no internet?
offline.body: GPS may still show your place. Sending an alert needs mobile data or SMS. If the server cannot send SMS, the app can open a draft on your phone. A draft is not a sent message until you send it.

help.tooShort: Describe the problem in a few words.
